scope: All8 256px crops in contact sheet; reviewed script and manifest; independently verified all source/native1024/output256 file hashes. Agent separately reviewed every native1024.
decision: Zero-border method removes the duplicate-hair artifact. Retain as candidate preprocessing, not an accepted complete training dataset. 144 loses top hair,145/147 are tight, multiple eye positions shift. Source photographs remain usable for a separate whole-image resize experiment.
user_requirement_note: No hats is required; an uncropped hair silhouette is not an explicit user requirement. Tight crops are a dataset consistency concern, not by themselves a production disqualifier.
